findings: SmallVec::from_buf constructs a one-element inline value. FromIterator reserves the iterator lower bound and extends in order; overflow spills to heap storage.
remove and insert shift elements to preserve order. Clone copies the current slice; capacity and spill state can differ from the original Vec.

SmallVec::retain preserves retained order but swaps rejected elements to the tail and drops them after traversal. Only the radical vector uses retain in this scope; its entries own Rational values, not opaque Computable values.

Terms can contain opaque owners through coefficients. Check ownership and drop behavior on cancellation, overflow and release; inline terms increase the coefficient/memo/stack footprint and must be measured.
